beers.name: Tempo
beers.about: Modern craft brewery founded in 2013, known for fruit-forward pales and IPAs, including its best-selling Lumina.
beers.taste: Bright and easy drinking. Sweet tropical fruit, sticky peach and citrus zest, finishing crisp with gentle bitterness.
beers.pairing: Fish and chips, grilled chicken, summer salads.

beers.name: Nectaron
beers.about: Started in Rutland in 1993 and based in Peterborough since 1998. Says it was the first UK brewery to brew commercially with Citra hops.

beers.name: Oracle
beers.about: Shropshire brewer that moved to a bigger site at Hadnall in 2014. Cask is its heart, with keg, cans and bottles added since.
beers.taste: Crisp, sunflower-gold ale with a striking hop profile. Floral and grapefruit, dry and refreshing with a long citrus finish.
beers.pairing: Grilled fish, chicken salad, mild cheeses.
beers.notes: Award-winning: International Beer Challenge best ale and SIBA bottled golden champion.

beers.name: Littlemore Citra
beers.about: Derbyshire brewery that began in 2007 in an old stable block.
beers.taste: Crisp and sharply citrus, lemon and grapefruit, with a bitter finish.

beers.name: Deception
beers.about: Sheffield brewery that has made Deception since 2008 and has passed 25 years of brewing.
beers.taste: Light, crisp and citrusy with a grapefruit bite.
beers.notes: A New Zealand-style pale ale built on Nelson Sauvin hops. Brewed since 2008.

beers.name: Spacelord
beers.about: Founded in 2012 by three friends. Brews modern, approachable beers and runs a large taproom on the brewery site.

beers.name: A King of Magic
beers.about: Independent Nottingham brewery, brewing since 1997, with its own small estate of pubs.

beers.name: Art of the Van
beers.about: Set up in 2014 by cycling and brewing enthusiasts Scott Povey and Sharon Bryant, hence the bike-themed names. Brews on an eight-barrel plant and began canning in 2021.

beers.name: Ghost Ship
beers.about: Suffolk coastal brewer based in Southwold. Ghost Ship is its best-selling beer.
beers.taste: Lemon and lime, elderflower aroma, biscuity malt and a famous hoppy finish.
beers.pairing: Ploughman's lunch, grilled meat, spicy food, pizza.
beers.notes: Built around Citra hops with rye crystal malt.

beers.name: How Soon is Now
beers.about: Shropshire brewer that moved to a bigger site at Hadnall in 2014. Cask is its heart, with keg, cans and bottles added since.

beers.name: Sowing the Seed
beers.about: Launched in 2013 as a self-styled 'pico' brewery. Now brews at FarGo Village in Coventry, with a taphouse on site.

beers.name: American Pale Ale
beers.about: Dark Star beers are listed by CAMRA as brewed by Fuller's in Chiswick. American Pale Ale is one of its classic cask beers.
beers.taste: Crisp and citrusy with a signature dry finish.
beers.notes: Cascade, Chinook and Centennial hops on Maris Otter malt.

beers.name: Fallen Angel
beers.about: Started in 1994 in an old coffin shop in Shustoke and moved to its current site in 2001. Known for one-off specials and old-recipe beers.
beers.notes: Voted Best Strong Bitter at the Great British Beer Festival.

beers.name: Silver King
beers.about: Founded in 1998 behind the Brewers Pride pub in Ossett. Silver King and Excelsius were the original beers.
beers.taste: Citrus aroma, clean and crisp, with a drier bitter finish.
beers.pairing: Fish and chips, chicken, light curries.
beers.notes: Lager malt and Cascade hops. An award winner since 2001.

beers.name: Sherbert Lemon
beers.about: Brewpub on the River Colne, brewing since 1995 and now part of the Ossett group. Its beer names are tied to local reservoirs.

beers.name: Blonde
beers.about: Founded in 2012 by three friends. Brews modern, approachable beers and runs a large taproom on the brewery site.

beers.name: Rat to the Future
beers.about: Brewery at the Rat & Ratchet pub, restarted in 2011 and part of the Ossett group. Known for rat-themed beer names.

beers.name: Ember
beers.about: Founded in November 2018 by university friends Sam Back and Oli Hurlow. Makes vegan beers and runs a taproom in Stirchley.

beers.name: Vicar's Ruin
beers.about: Started in 1994 in an old coffin shop in Shustoke and moved to its current site in 2001. Known for one-off specials and old-recipe beers.
beers.taste: Hoppy and bitter at first, softening to a delicate malt finish.

beers.name: Baltic Porter Coffee
beers.about: A collaboration. Titanic was founded in Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent in 1985 by brothers Keith and Dave Bott and is named after Captain Edward Smith, who came from Stoke. Castle Rock has brewed in Nottingham since 1997.
beers.taste: Soft chocolate and toasted malt with aromatic coffee and no harsh bitterness. A lighter, sessionable Baltic porter.
beers.pairing: Chocolate dessert, smoked sausage, blue cheese.
beers.notes: Collaboration brewed with Honduran coffee from Chartley Coffee, added in the mash.

beers.name: Blackheath Stour
beers.about: Set up in 2014 by cycling and brewing enthusiasts Scott Povey and Sharon Bryant, hence the bike-themed names. Brews on an eight-barrel plant and began canning in 2021.
beers.taste: Full-bodied and fruity, with an oaky bitterness and a creamy dark-fruit finish.
beers.notes: Fixed Wheel's first beer, named after its Black Country home. Champion Winter Beer of Britain 2020. New Zealand Pacific Gem and English Bramling Cross hops.

beers.name: Lumina
beers.about: Modern craft brewery founded in 2013, known for fruit-forward pales and IPAs, including its best-selling Lumina.
beers.taste: Juicy tropical fruit with a pillowy soft mouthfeel and a light haze.
beers.notes: Siren's best seller since 2020. Vegan and gluten free.

beers.name: It must be love
beers.about: Launched in 2013 as a self-styled 'pico' brewery. Now brews at FarGo Village in Coventry, with a taphouse on site.

beers.name: Signals
beers.about: Founded in November 2018 by university friends Sam Back and Oli Hurlow. Makes vegan beers and runs a taproom in Stirchley.
beers.taste: Citrus and stone fruit, leaning towards grapefruit and apricot.

beers.name: HBD
beers.about: Founded in November 2018 by university friends Sam Back and Oli Hurlow. Makes vegan beers and runs a taproom in Stirchley.

beers.name: Pina Colada
beers.about: Somerset cider maker known for its fruit ciders and its award-winning Bee Sting perry.
beers.taste: Pineapple, rum and coconut blended with crisp Somerset cider. Smooth, sweet and summery.

beers.name: Rhubarb
beers.about: Somerset cider maker known for its fruit ciders and its award-winning Bee Sting perry.
beers.taste: Sweet rhubarb flavour with a tart edge over a crisp apple base.

beers.name: Sunset
beers.about: Somerset cider maker known for its fruit ciders and its award-winning Bee Sting perry.
beers.taste: Full-bodied and fruity, bursting with juicy apple.

beers.name: Bee Sting
beers.about: Somerset cider maker known for its fruit ciders and its award-winning Bee Sting perry.
beers.taste: Sparkling, medium-sweet perry with a subtle pear aroma.
beers.notes: Award-winning perry. Gold, three-star Great Taste Award in 2018.
